behavior_constraints: Normalize transform maps to [-1,1] using formula 2*(x-min)/(max-min)-1 and returns 0.0 for zero-range
Promoting a new version to production demotes the old production version to staging instead of archived
weighted_mean aggregation reads weights from run.Metrics instead of run.Parameters, skipping runs lacking the weight metric
Template execution response includes template_info with template_name, resolved_params, and defaults_used (alphabetically sorted)
GET /api/v1/models/{name} response includes stage_summary with integer counts for all four stages (development, staging, production, archived)

Pipeline steps with skip_condition in config are skipped when the referenced variable exists and the condition evaluates true; skipped steps output {"status":"skipped","data":[]} and do not apply set_vars or output_transform
Skip condition supports operators gt, lt, eq, gte, lte, ne; missing variable means condition is ignored and step executes normally

GET /api/v1/experiments/{name}/metrics/{metric}/history returns chronological history of a metric across runs with run_id and value, count field; 404 if experiment missing, 400 with 'no values found' if no runs have the metric
PUT /api/v1/experiments/{name}/runs/{id} updates run metrics (new keys added, existing overwritten); returns updated run; 404 if experiment or run missing

POST /api/v1/experiments/{name}/runs/search filters runs by metric conditions (gt, lt, gte, lte, eq) with AND logic; runs missing a filtered metric are excluded; empty filters returns all runs; 404 if experiment missing; response includes runs array and count
affected_prior: ExecuteTransform normalize logic in internal/pipeline/steps.go (range change from [0,1] to [-1,1])
PromoteVersion in internal/registry/registry.go (demotion target change from archived to staging)
AggregateMetric weighted_mean in internal/experiment/experiment.go (weight source change from Parameters to Metrics)
ExecuteTemplate in internal/api/templates.go (response shape change with added template_info)
GetModel handler in internal/api/handlers.go (added stage_summary field)
entities.summary: This round changes normalize to [-1,1], production demotion to staging, weighted_mean weights to metrics, adds template_info and stage_summary fields, and introduces pipeline step skip conditions plus experiment metric history, run metric update, and run search endpoints.

## Behavioral Changes (Conflicts)

### Normalize Transform — Symmetric Range [-1, 1]

The normalize transform now maps values to the **[-1, 1]** range instead of [0, 1]:

- New formula: `2 * (x - min) / (max - min) - 1`
- When all values are identical (zero range), return **0.0** (the midpoint of [-1, 1]).
- This replaces the previous [0, 1] normalization a
